_meta.title: Governance domain graph — connectivity remediation (PROPOSAL ONLY)
_meta.purpose: Grounded feedback/reciprocal edges and redundant paths to remediate the findings from assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js (the audit module is domain-generic) run against assets/data/domains/governance.json. This is a recommendation artifact; it does NOT modify any live graph.
_meta.discipline: Every proposed edge carries a concrete grounding (a canonical-nodes.json regulatory fact OR the reciprocity of an existing governance.json edge). Candidates that could not be grounded are omitted and tallied under _omittedForLackOfGrounding.
_meta.doNotApply: Do not merge these edges into assets/data/domains/governance.json without an explicit apply step.
_meta.neuroReferenceThesis: Healthy circuits are ~80% recurrent/lateral; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure (diaschisis). A pure feedforward tree is the broken/cosmetic version.
_meta.pathologyVerdict: SAME CORE SIGNATURE AS FINANCE/ENERGY, with one structural difference in Governance's favor. Governance shows the identical feedforward pathology: ZERO reciprocal/feedback edges (recurrentFraction 0) despite carrying directed control rings, and many single points of failure (11 articulation nodes, the most of the three domains). DIFFERENCE: Governance's graph is a SINGLE connected component at baseline (baseComponents 1), NOT pre-fractured like Finance (whose {M1,SMA} dyad was disconnected, baseComponents 2). In Governance SMA->M1 sits inside the main body via ECN->SMA->STRI, so the motor pair is attached; SMA is merely an articulation point, not a severed component.

recurrenceAudit.note: ZERO reciprocal/feedback edges — the same feedforward-only signature the neuro reference calls the broken version. The graph carries directed cycles (the business-layer control ring dlPFC->BROCA->OFC->TPJ->FPN->vmPFC->dlPFC via CONTROLS+DEPENDS_ON edges), but for no edge A->B does B->A exist, so recurrentFraction is exactly 0. The module verdict is 'has recurrent/lateral structure' ONLY because lateralFractionOfClassifiable (0.343) clears the 0.2 lateral threshold; the feedback dimension is fully absent.

singlePointsOfFailure.baseComponentsNote: ONE connected component at baseline (34 nodes reachable through the edge list). Unlike Finance (baseComponents 2, a severed {M1,SMA} dyad), Governance has no pre-existing fracture; SMA->M1 hangs off the main body via ECN->SMA.

mechanismOfEachArticulation.SMA: sole attachment of leaf M1 (SMA->M1 is M1's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.NAcc: sole attachment of TWO reward-island stubs: VTA (VTA->NAcc is VTA's only edge) and VP (NAcc->VP is VP's only edge). Removing NAcc splits BOTH off as separate components.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.vmPFC: sole attachment of leaf PAG (vmPFC->PAG is PAG's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.dACC: sole bridge of the interoceptive island {AI, NTS, PI} to the main body — AI->dACC is that island's only link out
mechanismOfEachArticulation.THAL: sole attachment of leaf S1 (THAL->S1 only), leaf CBLM (CBLM->THAL only), the auditory relay island {A1, MGN}, and the visual island {V1, FEF, LGN}. THAL is the heaviest articulation point (removal yields 5 components).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.HIPP: sole attachment of leaf HPA (HPA->HIPP is HPA's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.BLA: sole attachment of leaf rACC (rACC->BLA is rACC's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.PVN: sole attachment of leaf HYPO (PVN->HYPO is HYPO's only edge; HYPO is a sink)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.V1: sole attachment of leaf LGN (LGN->V1 only) and leaf FEF (FEF->V1 is FEF's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.A1: sole attachment of leaf MGN (MGN->A1 is MGN's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.AI: sole attachment of leaves NTS (NTS->AI only) and PI (PI->AI only)

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the conflict-monitoring -> cognitive-control loop: the conflict/error signal feeds back to the executive to adjust control gain.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dlPFC->dACC (excit, 'executive recruits conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor', dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control'. dACC<->dlPFC are reciprocally connected (Botvinick conflict-control loop).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience-network loop; the two salience hubs must be mutually coupled to co-select what gets escalated.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge AI->dACC (excit, 'interoceptive -> conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; the anterior insula and dorsal ACC are the two defining hubs of the salience network and are reciprocally coupled by definition.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the context<->value loop; the context/valuation brake feeds back onto outcome valuation. Reciprocal of the existing OFC->vmPFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge OFC->vmPFC (excit, 'value -> context decision'). canonical-nodes vmPFC = M1 'top-down inhibitory brake', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'; adjacent medial/orbital PFC regions with dense reciprocal connectivity.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the valuation<->reward loop; the outcome-valuation stage feeds back to the reward driver. Reciprocal of the existing NAcc->OFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge NAcc->OFC (excit, 'reward -> value coding'). The orbitofrontal cortex is a principal glutamatergic corticostriatal input to the ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens (canonical OFC->NAcc). canonical-nodes OFC = M6 valuation, NAcc = M11 'incentive/reward drive'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the executive<->frontoparietal integration loop: the executive node feeds back onto the integrative analytical network it draws on.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge FPN->dlPFC (excit, 'fronto-parietal -> executive'). dlPFC is a core node of the fronto-parietal control network (FPN); the two are reciprocally coupled by definition. canonical-nodes dlPFC = executive control; FPN = composite fronto-parietal view.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the visual thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->V1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->V1 (excit, visual sensory relay). Layer-6 V1->LGN/pulvinar corticothalamic feedback outnumbers feedforward and is functionally gain/precision control -> modul. canonical-nodes THAL = M4 'gating relay / routing', V1 = 'primary visual processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the auditory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->A1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->A1 (excit, auditory sensory relay). A1->MGN corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory. canonical-nodes A1 = 'primary auditory processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the somatosensory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->S1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->S1 (excit, somatosensory relay). Layer-6 S1->VPL corticothalamic feedback is one of the most numerous projection classes in the brain. canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the cingulo-thalamic loop that the business-layer edge dACC->THAL (SUPPLIES) opens: the relay hub feeds the conflict monitor and the conflict monitor gates the relay.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dACC->THAL (SUPPLIES). The mediodorsal / anterior thalamic nuclei project to the anterior cingulate cortex (canonical thalamo-cingulate projection). canonical-nodes THAL = M4 routing hub, dACC = M6 conflict monitor.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: M1 reaches the graph only via SMA->M1, so removing SMA isolates it. A thalamocortical motor edge gives M1 a second afferent; removing SMA then leaves M1 attached via THAL. Also the canonical final leg of the cortico-basal-ganglia-thalamo-cortical motor loop whose output limb STRI->GP->THAL is already in-graph.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes THAL = M4 'gating relay / routing', M1 = 'primary motor cortex — motor output'. The ventral-anterior/ventral-lateral thalamus -> M1 projection is the canonical thalamocortical motor relay.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: GOVERNANCE-SPECIFIC: VTA reaches the graph ONLY via VTA->NAcc, so removing NAcc severs VTA entirely. A mesostriatal dopamine edge anchors VTA to the main-body hub STRI, so removing NAcc leaves VTA attached via STRI. (Unlike Finance, where VTA had another anchor and VP->VTA alone sufficed; here the reward source hangs entirely off NAcc and needs its own main-body anchor.)
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: The ventral tegmental area sends a canonical dopaminergic projection to the striatum (mesostriatal/mesolimbic dopamine). canonical-nodes VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source'. STRI is marked a COMPOSITE view in canonical-nodes; grounding rests on standard neuroanatomy (VTA -> ventral striatum), and STRI is already a main-body hub in-graph (SMA->STRI, STRI->CAUD, STRI->NAcc, STRI->GP).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: VP reaches the graph only via NAcc->VP, so removing NAcc isolates it. The reward-loop closure edge VP->VTA gives VP a second anchor (to VTA, itself now anchored to STRI by the edge above); removing NAcc then leaves VP attached via VTA. Doubles as recurrence: closes the mesolimbic loop VTA->NAcc->VP->VTA (hedonic output feeds back to regulate the dopamine source).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: In-graph the reward chain VTA->NAcc (excit) and NAcc->VP (inhib) already exists; the ventral pallidum sends GABAergic feedback to VTA (canonical mesolimbic disinhibition loop). canonical-nodes VP = 'ventral pallidum — reward/hedonic output', VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source'. Pair this with VTA->STRI so the {VTA,VP} island has an independent main-body bridge.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PAG reaches the graph only via vmPFC->PAG, so removing vmPFC isolates it. A central-amygdala -> PAG efferent gives PAG a second afferent; removing vmPFC then leaves PAG attached via CeA. Also closes the threat-appraisal -> defensive-output pathway.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes CeA = M7 'phasic fear output'; PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The central-amygdala -> periaqueductal-gray projection is the textbook fear-output pathway. CeA is already in the main body (CAUD->CeA, CeA->OFC, mPFC->CeA, vmPFC->CeA).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The interoceptive island {AI, NTS, PI} reaches the main body only via AI->dACC, so removing dACC isolates the whole island. An anterior-insula -> orbitofrontal edge gives the island a second bridge; removing dACC then leaves {AI, NTS, PI} attached via OFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: The anterior insula projects to the orbitofrontal cortex, carrying interoceptive/gustatory signal into valuation (canonical insula->OFC pathway). canonical-nodes AI = M10 interoceptive salience, OFC = M6 valuation.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches the auditory relay island {A1, MGN} to the main body via a cortical anchor off the THAL hub. PARTIAL de-articulation of THAL: it still isolates leaf S1, leaf CBLM, and the visual island (handled by the S1->M1 and FEF->dlPFC edges below; CBLM omitted), so THAL remains a residual articulation point for CBLM only.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; auditory cortex projects to the insular cortex (auditory-to-insula projection is documented; the insula integrates auditory salience).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches the visual island {V1, FEF, LGN} to the main body. The island hangs off THAL via THAL->V1; FEF (linked in only by FEF->V1) gets a frontal anchor via FEF->dlPFC, pulling V1 and LGN (via FEF->V1, LGN->V1) back to the main body when THAL is removed.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes FEF = 'frontal eye fields — attentional gaze control', dlPFC = executive control. FEF and dlPFC are both hubs of the dorsal fronto-parietal attention/executive network and are densely interconnected (canonical frontal attention connectivity).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches THAL's S1 leaf. S1 reaches the graph only via THAL->S1; a somatosensory -> motor edge anchors S1 to M1 (itself reconnected to the main body via SMA->M1 and the proposed THAL->M1). Removing THAL then leaves S1 attached via M1->SMA.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing', M1 = 'primary motor cortex — motor output'. The S1->M1 somatomotor projection is dense and canonical (the sensorimotor loop).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HPA reaches the graph only via HPA->HIPP, so removing HIPP isolates it. Cortisol also acts on the amygdala, giving HPA a second, well-grounded anchor; removing HIPP then leaves HPA attached via BLA.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Glucocorticoid (HPA-axis) output acts on the basolateral amygdala via glucocorticoid receptors, enhancing threat processing (textbook stress endocrinology). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition'. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks HPA as a COMPOSITE view; the cleaner long-run fix is to remap HPA to a view rather than treat it as a node.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: rACC reaches the graph only via rACC->BLA, so removing BLA isolates it. A medial-PFC affective-regulation edge gives rACC a second anchor; removing BLA then leaves rACC attached via vmPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes rACC = 'rostral ACC — affective appraisal & regulation', vmPFC = M1 top-down brake. rACC and vmPFC are adjacent ventromedial affective-regulation regions with reciprocal connectivity (the emotion-regulation medial-PFC cluster).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HYPO reaches the graph only via PVN->HYPO (HYPO is a sink), so removing PVN isolates it. A hypothalamic descending edge to PAG gives HYPO a second anchor; removing PVN then leaves HYPO attached via PAG (itself reattached to the main body by vmPFC->PAG and the proposed CeA->PAG).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes HYPO = M3 'homeostatic set-point'; PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The hypothalamus -> periaqueductal-gray descending projection is the canonical autonomic/defensive column (Bandler & Shipley). NOTE: PVN is NOT present in canonical-nodes.json (an in-graph node with no canonical entry); this edge is grounded on HYPO/PAG anatomy, and the cleaner long-run fix is to register or remap PVN.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: AI splits into TWO leaves on removal: PI (PI->AI only) and NTS (NTS->AI only). This edge reattaches the PI leaf: a posterior-insula -> cingulate interoceptive edge gives PI a second anchor. Paired with the NTS->PVN edge below, it fully de-articulates AI.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes PI = M10 'primary interoception', dACC = M6 conflict monitor / salience hub. Posterior/mid-insula interoceptive signals project to the anterior cingulate as part of the interoception-salience pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches AI's second leaf, NTS (NTS->AI only). A visceral-afferent -> hypothalamus edge gives NTS a second anchor; removing AI then leaves NTS attached via PVN. Together with PI->dACC this drops AI from the articulation set.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes NTS = M10 'visceral afferent hub'. The nucleus tractus solitarius sends a canonical ascending projection to the paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (visceral-afferent -> autonomic/neuroendocrine relay). PVN is already an in-graph node (target of mPFC->PVN, BLA->PVN, HIPP->PVN, LC->PVN; source of PVN->HYPO).

projectedImpact.method: The 22 proposed edges (9 feedback + 13 redundant/reconnection) were appended to a deep copy of governance.json in memory and re-scored with assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js. governance.json itself was NOT modified.

recurrentFraction.note: crosses the 0.2 tree-vs-mesh threshold; the 9 reciprocal pairs are exactly the 9 proposedFeedbackEdges (each is the reverse of a pre-existing edge).

baseComponents.note: already a single component; the redundant edges do not change component count, they remove articulation points.

articulationNodes.reason: All three residual articulation points survive solely because a dedicated sensory/relay leaf has no second grounded projection target present in the graph, so its redundant path was omitted rather than fabricated: THAL still cuts off CBLM; V1 still cuts off LGN; A1 still cuts off MGN. This is the same honest floor Finance and Energy bottomed out at (identical LGN/MGN reason; Governance adds CBLM).

candidates.candidate: redundant path around THAL via a second edge on CBLM
candidates.reason: CBLM reaches the graph only via CBLM->THAL. The thalamus does not project to the cerebellum, and cerebellar cortical input arrives polysynaptically via the pontine nuclei (no direct cortex->CBLM fiber to any in-graph node). No honest second edge, so CBLM stays a leaf of THAL and THAL stays a residual articulation point for it.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around V1 via a second edge on LGN
candidates.reason: LGN is a dedicated retino-recipient thalamic relay whose only cortical target is V1; the pulvinar / superior-colliculus partners that would give it a second grounded projection are not present as nodes in the governance graph. LGN stays a leaf of V1. (FEF, V1's other dependent leaf, IS reattached via FEF->dlPFC, so V1's residual articulation is for LGN alone.)

candidates.candidate: redundant path around A1 via a second edge on MGN
candidates.reason: MGN is a dedicated cochlea-recipient (medial geniculate) auditory thalamic relay whose only cortical target is A1; no second grounded projection target exists among the graph's nodes. MGN stays a leaf of A1.

_omittedForLackOfGrounding.notedButNotOmitted: The S1->THAL corticothalamic FEEDBACK edge (proposedFeedbackEdges) and the S1->M1 REDUNDANT edge both involve S1; they are independent (one is thalamic feedback, one is the somatomotor reattachment) and both are separately grounded. No S1 candidate is omitted.
